# telnyx_ai_conversation_insight (Resource)

An insight template, the instructions an AI model follows to extract an insight from each conversation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_ai_conversation_insight" "example" {
  name         = "Customer sentiment"
  instructions = "Rate the customer's sentiment from 1 (angry) to 5 (delighted)."
}

resource "telnyx_ai_conversation_insight_group" "example" {
  name = "Support quality"
}

resource "telnyx_ai_conversation_insight_group_assignment" "example" {
  group_id   = telnyx_ai_conversation_insight_group.example.id
  insight_id = telnyx_ai_conversation_insight.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instructions` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `json_schema` (String) If specified, the output will follow the JSON schema. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `webhook` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `insight_type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_ai_conversation_insight.example <id>
```
